execution_ownership.sdk_nonce_scope: globalNonceManager and semaphore are process-local only
execution_ownership.required_topology: one protected executor and one durable input queue per distinct Privy agent address and Hyperliquid network; no warm or concurrent signer-capable standby
execution_ownership.executor_identity: each executor receives a distinct Privy agent address that is never reused by any replacement
execution_ownership.queue_lease_scope: a lease may select the queue consumer only; it cannot revoke signer access, fence an ExchangeClient, or prove the old process stopped
execution_ownership.replacement_gate: terminate old infrastructure; owner revokes old Hyperliquid agent authorization; Privy revokes old agent signing authority; credentialed negative signing probe proves an old-instance request is rejected by Privy; reconcile unknown actions; only then start a replacement with a new distinct agent address
execution_ownership.pause_after_check: any second instance, ownership ambiguity, or signer-capable process observed after a queue check pauses all SDK calls and enters operator hold
forbidden: application lease claimed as provider or signer fence
cross-process use of SDK globalNonceManager as coordination

trading_eligibility.production_mutation_scope: every Hyperliquid /exchange action and every Privy/owner or agent signer request, including order, cancel, modify, leverage, margin, agent authorization, withdrawal, transfer, and funding mutations
trading_eligibility.read_only_scope: public Info and market WebSocket reads are separately scoped and can never enable a signer, Exchange action, account mutation, or funds movement
trading_eligibility.approved_evidence: every required decision is exact approved with nonempty authoritative evidence_ref and policy_version, integer checked_at_ms/expires_at_ms, checked_at_ms <= now_ms < expires_at_ms
trading_eligibility.enforcement: one mandatory pre-SDK production mutation gate evaluates the exact user, account, jurisdiction, product, action, provider terms, and evidence versions; no ExchangeClient or Privy signing call occurs unless all technical and eligibility gates approve
trading_eligibility.r0_result: all production mutations blocked; no eligibility evidence has been approved

market_scope.asset_binding: asset index and coin must come from the same fresh Core meta universe snapshot and immutable allowlist
market_scope.info_dex_rule: every Info request that accepts dex must send the exact empty string
market_scope.coin_rule: reject colon-prefixed or dex-qualified coins including xyz:*

offline_html_fixture.label: Simulated Hyperliquid testnet fixture — no network, signing, or submission

schemes.l1_actions: msgpack action + nonce + vault marker/address + expiresAfter marker/value -> keccak -> Agent EIP-712
schemes.user_signed_actions: HyperliquidSignTransaction EIP-712 with action-specific primary type

signing.implementation: pinned @nktkas/hyperliquid SDK only, using Privy-backed wallet accounts; LOOP never encodes, hashes, or signs

privy_boundary.owner_wallet: Privy user-owned wallet or connected external wallet
privy_boundary.agent_wallet: Privy-managed embedded EVM wallet registered by owner

nonce.scope: per signer, shared across master/subaccount/vault targets
nonce.manager: pinned @nktkas/hyperliquid ExchangeClient globalNonceManager with its per-wallet-and-network request lock
nonce.loop_role: one long-lived ExchangeClient inside one protected executor per distinct agent address/network; never generate, increment, persist, override, or reuse nonces
nonce.window: Hyperliquid retains the 100 highest nonces; each new nonce must be unused and greater than the smallest retained

operations.client_order_id: required unique 128-bit lowercase hex for every order, modify replacement, and batchModify replacement
operations.decimal_policy: provider decimal strings only; never IEEE-754 arithmetic for prices, sizes, margin, PnL, funding, or liquidation

order_schema.cloid: required unique lowercase 0x plus 32 hex digits

market_order_review.source: fresh provider bbo or l2Book message from pinned SDK

source_revision_policy.authority: LOOP adapter-generated identity, never a provider field
source_revision_policy.subscription_epoch: new opaque epoch on every reconnect
source_revision_policy.arrival_sequence: strictly increasing for every raw message within one subscription epoch before normalization
source_revision_policy.raw_message_sha256: sha256 of the exact raw WebSocket message UTF-8 bytes before normalization
source_revision_policy.same_timestamp: messages sharing provider time remain distinct when sequence or digest differs

canonical_quote_parser.authority: one strict exact-decimal parser consumes the exact hashed SDK-delivered raw frame and atomically emits source kind, coin, provider time, bid/ask price, size, and level count
canonical_quote_parser.schema_non_interchangeability: channel bbo requires only data.bbo semantics; channel l2Book requires only data.levels semantics; no relabeling or cross-parser fallback
canonical_quote_parser.correlation: one synchronous immutable envelope per SDK-delivered raw frame before any await; never join raw and normalized records by coin, provider time, callback order, or latest cache
canonical_quote_parser.normalized_digest: sha256 of UTF-8 RFC8259 JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, and provider decimal strings preserved exactly
canonical_quote_parser.source_envelope_digest: sha256 of canonical provider, network, subscription epoch, arrival sequence, raw-message sha256, source kind, coin, provider time, and normalized bid/ask price, size, and count
canonical_quote_parser.transport_gate: PENDING until the pinned SDK transport exposes the exact raw frame and atomic callback correlation; no parallel WebSocket or custom feed is allowed

price_policy.implementation: thin adapter over mature decimal.js only after complete dependency lock; never delegate both sides to SDK ROUND_DOWN
price_policy.dependency_gate: PENDING full transitive version/source/integrity/license lock blocks production
price_policy.grid_rule: same fresh Core meta plus official tick and significant-digit constraints
price_policy.rounding: buy chooses greatest valid grid price at or below upper bound; sell chooses least valid grid price at or above lower bound; reject if rounding no longer crosses BBO
price_policy.zero_liquidity: reject buy without ask and sell without bid

market_order_review.structural_identity_invariant: review.coin == normalized_quote.coin == fresh_core_meta.coin == order_intent.coin; review.source_kind == normalized_quote.source_kind == raw subscription channel; review/order asset == fresh Core meta asset; provider/network/epoch/sequence/raw hash/source kind/coin/provider time/normalized prices and sizes are committed by source_envelope_sha256 before IOC calculation
market_order_review.final_order: immutable reviewed order_intent carries coin and asset; Hyperliquid wire carries the same asset index, exact-decimal price/size, tif Ioc, and grouping na
market_order_review.decimal_rule: BBO prices, size, max slippage, and final IOC limit are decimal strings; no IEEE-754
market_order_review.re_review: every invalidation requires a new provider snapshot and a new owner review

builder_policy.future_enablement_gate: new owner-approved audit with exact lowercase LOOP address, exact fee cap, main-wallet approval, maxBuilderFee and approvedBuilders readback, credentialed testnet evidence, and new mutations

websocket.snapshot_delta: SDK subscription payloads are authoritative; time-series snapshots precede events per subscription; each l2Book message replaces the displayed book atomically; never reconstruct an orderbook from trades or custom diffs
websocket.heartbeat: send ping before 60s idle timeout; reconnect on missed pong or close
websocket.liquidation_ui_rule: show only raw aggregate liquidation values; per-coin rows require provider fills and clearinghouse readback; never invent time, coin, or szi
websocket.ordering: partition by subscription key; reject older epoch; stable-sort snapshot rows by provider timestamp then provider id; never invent global ordering
websocket.gap_policy: mark stale, disable mutations dependent on stale state, fetch authoritative Info snapshots, then resume

rate_limits.pre_sdk_unique_user_gate: ten distinct users allowed; eleventh distinct user rejected before SDK subscribe
rate_limits.sdk_known_drift: @nktkas/hyperliquid v0.33.2 hard-codes 15 unique users; LOOP enforces current official 10 first
rate_limits.client_policy: central token buckets by IP and signer; queue or fail before provider; Retry-After else exponential backoff with jitter; never retry signed mutation blindly

errors.batch_shape: accept either one pre-validation error for the whole batch or one status per item
errors.unknown_submission: freeze affected intent; do not resubmit; run the action-specific reconciliation policy; future nonce handling remains inside the pinned SDK

reconciliation.submission_identity: account_address + network + action_kind + required cloid for order replacements or oid for cancels + immutable_review_intent_digest + opaque_adapter_request_id
reconciliation.state_precedence: Info/Exchange confirmed terminal state > websocket delta > local pending; local state never fabricates fills, positions, funding, liquidation, or settlement
reconciliation.retention: persist intent digest and non-secret identifiers; never persist signatures, Privy authorization keys, app secret, or agent private key

per_action.order: required unique cloid -> orderStatus by cloid + openOrders + userFillsByTime + clearinghouseState
per_action.modify: replacement required unique cloid -> orderStatus by cloid + openOrders + userFillsByTime + clearinghouseState
per_action.batchModify: every replacement required unique cloid -> reconcile every cloid independently; whole batch remains held until all items resolve
per_action.cancel: oid -> orderStatus + openOrders; unknownOid stays quarantined until fills/readback or operator decision
per_action.approveAgent: extraAgents readback for exact agent address/name/validUntil
per_action.updateLeverage: clearinghouseState exact coin leverage type/value readback
per_action.updateIsolatedMargin: clearinghouseState exact coin isolated margin and position fields readback
per_action.scheduleCancel: operator_hold_no_auto_retry because no authoritative schedule read endpoint
per_action.approveBuilderFee_future_only: maxBuilderFee plus approvedBuilders readback; disabled in R0

status_policy.scope: Core perpetual non-trigger limit orders only
status_policy.excluded_reason: trigger/TP-SL, vault, or spot status outside the approved R0 action schema
status_policy.unknown_status: quarantine and operator review; never coerce to success, failure, or terminal
status_policy.unknown_oid: quarantine and reconcile fills/open orders/positions; never treat as proof the action was absent

numeric_rules.wire_prices_and_sizes: exact decimal strings validated against meta.szDecimals and official tick/lot rules
numeric_rules.leverage: integer bounded by metadata maxLeverage and position margin mode
numeric_rules.market_ioc_rounding: mature decimal.js thin policy after full dependency lock: buy rounds toward lower aggression and sell toward lower aggression, then both revalidate crossing and slippage; SDK uniform ROUND_DOWN is forbidden

go_live_gate.production_mutation_enablement: the single pre-SDK technical and eligibility gate must approve every action; unknown, missing, pending, stale, malformed, or denied evidence blocks order, cancel, account mutation, signing, and funds movement
go_live_gate.read_only_independence: public market data may pass a separately approved read-only gate that has no path to ExchangeClient or Privy signing
